title: knowledge-lint pin: the CLI-guard pin runs the real CLI with --init-state against the real repo, which would write a lint-state.json into the checkout if that file were ever removed
evidence: tools/knowledge-lint.pin.test.ts runs knowledge-lint.ts --init-state on the repo and expects the "lint-state.json exists" refusal; a read-only flag would pin the guard without that risk (review of PR 1425)
